subjects.label: Strawberries and full completion
subjects.description: The strawberries, golden berries and crystal hearts as collectibles and as the game's running joke, and whether chasing 100% is worth it; not the main climb to the credits.

subjects.label: Rage and masochism
subjects.description: The game as suffering enjoyed on purpose: pain, burnt backsides, blood pressure, being a masochist, coming to suffer together, and stress rather than relief; not whether the difficulty is fair or well tuned.

subjects.label: Sore hands and broken controllers
subjects.description: The physical cost of playing: carpal tunnel, a ruined thumb, a stiff neck, headaches, and keyboards or controllers worn out or smashed; not the frustration itself.

subjects.label: Transgender and queer reading
subjects.description: The game read as a story about a trans woman and what it does to its players: HRT, egg cracking, the pipeline, lesbian jokes, and the complaint that it preaches political correctness; not the plot or characters in general.

subjects.label: Mental health and the other self
subjects.description: The story's treatment of anxiety, depression and the shadow self: the second Madeline who will not help, inner demons, Jung, and thanking the flawed self that never gave up; not the plot beats or the supporting cast.

subjects.label: Dash, movement and speedrunning
subjects.description: The dash and climb as a movement system: the eight-way dash, diagonal inputs the controller misreads, fancy footwork, and movement built with speedrunning in mind; not how hard the levels are.

subjects.label: Chapters, B-sides and Farewell
subjects.description: Which chapter or side broke you: Farewell, the B and C sides, Reflection B, chapter 8, chapter 3, the one room that took twelve hours; not how hard the game is overall.

subjects.label: The mountain and the summit
subjects.description: The climb as motif and goal: why climb at all, climbing together, reaching the summit, the mountain as the thing the game is about; not the level layouts or the cast.
